runtime_contract_lineage_repair.description: Exact Unified-Registry -> Hash-Lineage -> runtime-contract repair scope. It permits only the canonical contract registry, its active runtime projection, strict hash/interface guards, the exact formal-signal Artifact materialization edge from Signal Pool into Artifact Transport, Product Signal Admission as the mandatory business gate before Agent1, the exact admission-qualified formal-signal -> Agent1 handoff inside the existing single worker, deterministic Agent1 projection de-duplication under the unchanged 22k item budget, Agent3 exact-path semantic repair, completed-contract projection, Agent stage Artifact refs and structured current-state failure projection. The V22 runtime installer is allowed only for the exact authority correction that stops release-version projection from overwriting the immutable operating-evidence contract version; it must not add a new Signal Pool dependency or compatibility bridge. Product detail hash-cache recovery is limited to the existing canonical product authority, the V21.7 trend algorithm bridge, the existing V22.5.6 detail route and the existing frontend Hash View client: historical canonical sets must be scanned one row at a time and reduced immediately to the requested product; one content-addressed immutable product-detail Artifact may be materialized and reused; the browser may reuse that detail only while the current frontend manifest hash is unchanged. Signal Pool may call the existing Artifact Transport only to materialize the registered immutable signal.signal_ref after evidence-contract validation; it must preserve dataVersion, signalId, sourceSignalId, product/store identity and sourceRef, must not create a second queue/worker, and must fail closed when ART-* validation fails. Competition handoff may consume only status=admitted_for_judgment and must never promote pending_rag_agent, observed_soft_gate or weak/noise rows into Agent1. Agent1 input projection may remove duplicate representations and bound optional summaries but must preserve every field-signal semantic item, sourceLineageValidation, the immutable signalRef parent, evidence decision semantics, the existing 22000 character hard limit and fail-closed validation. Runtime membership may change only when the added/removed file is explicitly allowlisted or owned by an explicitly allowed registry module. All unrelated production files, modules, nodes and special hashes remain fail-closed.
